api_key.description: API key used for authentication (sent as X-API-Key). Can be set via ARCANE_API_KEY.

endpoint.description: Base API endpoint for Arcane (e.g., http://localhost:3552/api).

forget_missing_environments.description: When true, per-environment resources (project, container, volume, network, gitops_sync, notification) whose environment no longer exists are removed from state on read instead of failing with the manager's "environment not found" proxy error. Defaults to false (the read errors). Enable this when you recreate environments with new IDs.

http_timeout.description: HTTP request timeout (e.g., 120s, 2m). Defaults to 120s if unset or invalid.

insecure.description: Disable TLS certificate verification for API requests. Use only with self-signed.

description.description: Optional description of the API key (max 1000 characters)

expires_at.description: Optional expiration date for the API key (RFC3339 format, e.g., '2025-12-31T23:59:59Z')

id.description: Unique identifier of the API key

is_bootstrap.description: Whether the API key is an auto-generated environment bootstrap key.

is_static.description: Whether the API key is environment-managed and protected from deletion.

key.description: The full API key secret. Only available on creation - cannot be retrieved later.

key_prefix.description: Prefix of the API key for identification

last_used_at.description: Last time the API key was used

name.description: Name of the API key (1-255 characters)

environment_id.description: Environment ID to scope the grant to; omit for a global grant.

permissions.description: Permission grants for the key (at least one). Each grant is a permission string with an optional environment scope (omit environment_id for a global grant). Cannot exceed the creating user's own permissions.

user_id.description: ID of the user who owns the API key

block.description: Manages an API key for programmatic access to Arcane.

fail_if_name_exists.description: If true, fail during the plan phase when a container with the same name already exists in the environment, instead of letting Arcane reject the create at apply time. Defaults to false.

api_key.description: Pairing API key (only returned on creation).

edge_capabilities.description: Capabilities reported by the edge agent.

edge_mtls_certificate_json.description: Edge mTLS certificate metadata as JSON.

is_edge.description: Whether the environment uses edge transport.

regenerate_api_key.description: Regenerate the pairing API key on update.

use_api_key.description: When true, generates an API key for agent pairing.

audiences.description: Allowed external token audiences (at least one).

environment_id.description: Optional environment scope for the role assignment.

id.description: Unique identifier of the federated credential.

identity_user_id.description: Dedicated service user ID backing issued tokens.

role_id.description: Mapped role ID granted to exchanged tokens.

subject_claim.description: Claim path to match against; defaults to 'sub'.

subject_match.description: Exact subject or anchored glob pattern to match.

block.description: Manages a workload identity federation trust rule. Allows an external OIDC issuer to exchange tokens for an Arcane service token bound to a role.

compose_path.description: Path to docker-compose file in the repository

environment_variables.description: Environment variables for the synced project

fail_if_name_exists.description: If true, fail during the plan phase when a GitOps sync with the same name already exists in the environment, instead of creating a duplicate. Defaults to false.

max_sync_binary_size.description: Maximum binary file size to sync in bytes

max_sync_files.description: Maximum number of files to sync

max_sync_total_size.description: Maximum total sync size in bytes

project_name.description: Project name for the synced compose stack

start_project.description: Whether to start the project after creation (default: true). This is not sent to the API but controls lifecycle behavior.

sync_directory.description: Whether to sync the full directory instead of only the compose file

analytics_heartbeat_interval.description: Cron expression for analytics heartbeat (e.g., '0 */5 * * * *' for every 5 minutes)

auto_update_interval.description: Cron expression for auto-update checks (e.g., '0 0 2 * * *' for daily at 2 AM)

docker_client_refresh_interval.description: Cron expression for Docker client refresh

environment_health_interval.description: Cron expression for environment health checks (e.g., '0 */1 * * * *' for every minute)

event_cleanup_interval.description: Cron expression for event log cleanup (e.g., '0 0 3 * * *' for daily at 3 AM)

expired_sessions_cleanup_interval.description: Cron expression for expired session cleanup

gitops_sync_interval.description: Cron expression for GitOps sync checks (e.g., '0 */10 * * * *' for every 10 minutes)

polling_interval.description: Cron expression for general polling operations (e.g., '0 */5 * * * *' for every 5 minutes)

scheduled_prune_interval.description: Cron expression for scheduled pruning of Docker resources (e.g., '0 0 1 * * 0' for weekly on Sunday at 1 AM)

block.description: Manages cron schedules for automated background jobs in an environment. All intervals use cron format.

driver.description: Network driver (e.g., bridge, overlay, host, macvlan). Defaults to 'bridge'.

internal.description: Restrict external access to the network

scope.description: Scope of the network (local or swarm)

block.description: Manages a Docker network for container communication.

claim_value.description: OIDC claim value to match (e.g. a group name).

environment_id.description: Environment ID to scope the assignment to; omit for a global assignment.

role_id.description: ID of the role to assign when the claim matches.

source.description: How the mapping was created (manual or env).

block.description: Maps an OIDC group/claim value to a role. On each OIDC login, a user's group claim is matched against claim_value and matching rows become role assignments. Manages only manual mappings; mappings declared via the OIDC_ROLE_MAPPINGS env var are read-only.

fail_if_name_exists.description: If true, fail during the plan phase when a project with the same name already exists in the environment (including folders Arcane has discovered on disk), instead of letting Arcane auto-rename the new project with a numeric suffix. Defaults to false.

pull_on_update.description: Pull images before redeploy when compose/env changes.

redeploy_on_update.description: Redeploy the project after updating compose/env content.

remove_orphans.description: When deploying (compose up), remove containers for services not defined in the compose file.

running.description: If true, ensure project is running (compose up); if false, compose down. If unset, no lifecycle management.

content_hash_mode.description: If true, store only content hashes in state instead of full file contents.

pull_on_update.description: Pull images before redeploy when compose/env changes.

built_in.description: Whether this is a built-in role (always false for managed roles).

name.description: Display name of the role (1-100 characters).

permissions.description: Permission strings granted by this role (at least one), e.g. 'containers:start'.

block.description: Manages a custom RBAC role. Built-in roles (Admin/Editor/Deployer/Viewer) are read-only and cannot be managed by this resource.

applied.description: All environment settings after apply (key -> value).

data.description: Secret value (plaintext). The provider encodes this to base64 for the API.

resolve_image.description: Image resolution mode for deploy (for example always, changed, or never)

services.description: Number of services in the stack

with_registry_auth.description: Forward registry authentication to swarm agents during deploy

working_dir.description: Working directory used by Arcane for compose include resolution

username.description: Username of the user. Changing forces a new resource.

containers.description: List of containers using this volume
